scope.structure_aggregation: mean within positive images of each of16 structures,then equal macro;then seeds mean and sample SD
scope.union_aggregation: mean within positive images of each of9 domains,then equal macro;then seeds mean and sample SD
scope.union_main_cohort: positive_surface_defined:1601 of1603 positive images;2 AUL GT-boundary-undefined cases excluded consistently
scope.shared_model: 16-output multihead shared U-Net;not the single-channel union U-Net
scope.statistical_limit: 3 seeds descriptive paired comparisons,no significance claim;tests historically inspected

rule.prerequisite: all 27 Q01 runs verified at 80 epochs; validation history only
rule.first: maximum number of runs with a Q01 guardrail checkpoint
rule.second: maximum mean abdomen positive Dice at the original overall-best validation checkpoint
rule.third: maximum mean 16-structure positive Dice at that same checkpoint
rule.reuse: one common main-loss arm for all 12 Q02 runs; immutable after finalization
